import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_completed_square_interval_sublevel_characterization
    (a c r : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hf : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = (x - a)^2 + c) :
    a ∈ Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r) ∧
      IsMinOn f (Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r)) a ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r) → (f x ≤ c ↔ x = a) := by
  have h₁ : a ∈ Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r) := by
    constructor <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try linarith) <;>
    (try ring_nf at * <;> nlinarith)
    <;>
    nlinarith
  
  have h₂ : IsMinOn f (Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r)) a := by
    refine' isMinOn_iff.mpr _
    intro x hx
    rw [hf]
    rw [hf]
    have h₃ : (x - a) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by nlinarith
    have h₄ : a ∈ Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r) := h₁
    simp only [Set.mem_Icc] at hx ⊢
    nlinarith [hx.1, hx.2]
  
  have h₃ : ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Icc (a - r) (a + r) → (f x ≤ c ↔ x = a) := by
    intro x hx
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₄ : f x = (x - a) ^ 2 + c := hf x
      rw [h₄] at h
      have h₅ : (x - a) ^ 2 + c ≤ c := by linarith
      have h₆ : (x - a) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by nlinarith
      have h₇ : (x - a) ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith
      have h₈ : x - a = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have h₉ : x = a := by linarith
      exact h₉
    · 
      intro h
      rw [h]
      have h₄ : f a = (a - a) ^ 2 + c := hf a
      rw [h₄]
      <;> nlinarith
  
  exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
